description: Trata sobre el petróleo  , que afecta Alos animales, y a humanos , petróleo busca tratar más rápido las fugas de petróleo
summary: It's an app that will help us detect an oil spill or a fire through satellites, sensors, and human watchers, all connected, and if they coincide, it sends an alert to civil protection in less than 24 hours, thus preventing pollution and diseases.
details: It sends alerts to civil protection when there are possible oil spills. Its benefits are that it reduces air and water pollution and considerably decreases animal deaths. We want this project to have a positive impact on the population and at the same time raise awareness.
